title: GPT-6 model routing and durable Herdr session recovery

statements.text: Use GPT-6 Astra for the OpenCode default, Plan, GPT Build, GPT command and OpenAI reviewer routes.
Use Opus 5.5 for Claude Build and its command while preserving the configured Vertex provider boundary.
Remove GPT-5.6 from active managed model routing, including smaller OpenAI helpers and Hermes; preserve historical evidence and accounting identities.
Use catalog-supported GPT-6 Sol for Builder and Scout and GPT-6 Luna for Explore and small-model work; do not invent an unavailable GPT-6 Terra route.
Repair paced startup so a supported concurrent restoration burst is not rejected as unavailable storage merely because other sessions are progressing.
Preserve unresolved exact-session restoration entries across capture and restart without overwriting occupied panes, duplicating sessions, or resurrecting intentionally closed sessions.
Preserve running sessions during source implementation; the original no-restart hold is now conditionally released only after complete private recovery coverage, backups and workload qualification.
Deliver only this session's changes through pull requests into main after required checks; preserve unrelated Discovery commits and untracked relocation work outside delivery.
A startup timeout does not prove lost conversation history; current health and surviving session metadata cannot establish the exact incident-time lock failure.
Separate source and fixture qualification from deployment and live restart qualification; release of the operator's no-restart hold is required before live recovery testing.
Capture and recognize exact native OpenCode conversation identity even when the process has no explicit session argument; refuse malformed or conflicting identity without erasing recovery intent.
Qualify an eighty-session restoration burst with at least five-second spacing, twenty-second no-progress detection and a ten-minute total admission bound.
Update eligible Homebrew formulae and casks after the macOS upgrade, rebuild mismatched pkgconf, preserve rollback kegs and avoid unapproved trust changes or database migrations.
Update managed Herdr, OpenCode and Codex through verified stable release paths on the host and registered workspaces, retaining state boundaries and rollback checks.
The operator authorizes a controlled Herdr restart after complete private inventory, backups and actual-scale qualification; never bypass the old server's sixty-four-pane live-handoff limit.
A denied VM-control capability remains blocked until its permission route is explicitly resolved; do not recreate denied commands through helpers or another runtime.
The operator defers VM operations and the coupled managed OpenCode/Codex fleet updater; proceed with independent host recovery and Herdr rollout without changing fleet targets or runtime authority.
The operator approves a complete private SQLite backup when native exports fail on a large existing conversation; verify integrity and all expected identities before any restart.

When a configured central state root is present and XDG_DATA_HOME is absent, standalone recovery resolves the central OpenCode database rather than legacy internal state; retain explicit XDG overrides and fail closed on missing configured data.
